name: Uvall
wishes: a flared cross whose top arm is the entering stem (three flared arms) and whose foot is a bell; rendered here as cross plus tri
notes: Same plan as 47a, narrower: ring at the top-left of a short rail; a left post with a cross-bar carrying a square bay; one box hanging from the rail around a flared cross; a five-bar meander whose first bar is the stem down to a wide flared cross on a bell foot; a stepped right outline ending in a stem with a small flared cross instead of the diagonal cross.
